newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fdlot cattle trade actively up $1-$2-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fdlot cattle trade actively up $1-$2-USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers in Nebraska was active Tuesday, USDA said.
Live sales mostly $2.00 higher than mid-session last week; dressed basis $1.00 to instances $2.00 higher than Monday.
Demand good. Seller interest good at top side of quotes.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 66.00-67.00; dressed basis 106.00 to many 107.00. ( weighted average 106.78 ).
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs 66.00-67.00, few early to 65.00; dressed basis 106.00-107.00. ( weighted average 106.65 ).
Sales Confirmed: 28,000 Last Week: 600 Last Year: 11,500
Week To Date: 41,000 Last Week: 10,600 Last Year: 17,000
Live basis sales Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
